oneLine: aex is an agent execution platform for launching autonomous agents from a simple TypeScript SDK and CLI.
description: Submit typed runs, stream durable events, capture outputs, and compose agents with skills, files, MCP, proxy endpoints, and subagents across the managed runtime.

typescriptLines: const aex = new AgentExecutor({ apiToken: process.env.AEX_API_TOKEN! });
prompt: "Write the report and save outputs.",
for await (const event of aex.stream(runId)) console.log(event.type);

featureAreas.title: Agent runtime
featureAreas.description: Managed autonomous runs with filesystem read/edit, grep/glob/head/tail, open web fetch/search defaults, optional notebook tools, and post-hook repair.

featureAreas.title: Durable infrastructure
featureAreas.description: Run records, status, wait/cancel/delete, idempotency, typed events, output capture, downloads, timeouts, and runtime sizes.

featureAreas.title: Agent composition
featureAreas.description: Skills, files, AGENTS.md, remote MCP servers, proxy endpoints, environment variables, packages, and networking controls.

featureAreas.title: Subagents
featureAreas.description: Typed parent/child lineage for async child runs, output handoff, and bounded agent delegation.

featureAreas.title: Models and providers
featureAreas.description: Anthropic, DeepSeek, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, OpenRouter, Doubao, and Doubao China behind one submission shape.

featureAreas.title: Typed control surface
featureAreas.description: Strongly typed SDK inputs, CLI parity, BYOK secrets, scoped proxy auth, redaction, and output modes.
